bioghist.head: Biographical Information
bioghist.p: Margaret Edds (1947-), former reporter and editor of the Richmond Times-Dispatch. Her writing focuses on racial justice and she has authored six books including; An Expendable Man: The Near-Execution of Earl Washington Jr., We Face the Dawn, and What the Eyes Can't See: Ralph Northam, Black Resolve, and a Racial Reckoning in Virginia.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Research papers, 1960-2007, of Margaret Edds, (1947-), of Richmond, Virginia, containing research on her book The Expendable Man: The Near Execution of Earl Washington Jr., consisting of court records, electronic correspondence, interviews, letters (correspondence), newspaper clippings, and other documents.
